Author: Rayla Petal
Name: WatchAlong
Description:
Puts a Kosmi room on a screen inside FFXIV, joining as a real Kosmi guest via a
sandboxed out-of-process browser, so playback stays perfectly synced with the rest of the room.

Commands:
/wa - toggle the main viewer/control window
/wa view - open the main window
/wa join <kosmi url or WA1: invite> - join a room, or accept an invite (with confirmation)
/wa settings - open Settings (identity, volume/mute, join/leave, invite, screen placement)
/wa invite - copy a shareable invite for your current room and screen
/wa sync <WA1P: message> - apply a shared screen position (with confirmation)
/wa place - open the screen placement window
/wa focus - snap the camera to a fullscreen view of your placed screen (move to exit)
/wa forgetvenues - forget every remembered watch-along room (stops auto-rejoining any of them)
/wa vol <0-150> - set volume
/wa mute - toggle mute
/wa snapshot - save a debug screenshot + DOM outline
Punchline: Watch a Kosmi room together, in-game.

Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
PoseKit 3.0

Quick Library
- A small on-screen chip opens a compact animation library. Shown while paired by default; Settings can hide it when solo or never show it (/posekit lib still opens the library).
- Laid out like the main window: your mods, then each animation, then its roles and variants with small play buttons.
- Only shows what you can play right now (standing, seated or lying down), and opens by itself when you sit or lie down (optional).
- Adjust section with the gizmo and Bone Align, and a Rescan button.

Favorites
- Star any playable animation in the main window or the library; favorites get their own section above your mods.

Posing
- Doze anywhere: doze poses play where you stand, and others see them.
- Gizmo: drag handles on your character to move or turn your offset.
- Bone Align faces your partner's direction first ("Face partner's direction", on by default).
- Nudging a remembered animation by hand saves it to Bone Align's memory.

Pairing
- Pair with your target from the library or main window, or right-click a player and choose "Pair with PoseKit". Invites pop up as a notification.
- Pairing tells are hidden from chat and spaced out so the game doesn't drop them.
- The library pairs like the main window (queue, override, partner's pick, Unpair).

Fixes
- Options from mods saved by newer Penumbra versions play again.
- Dropdowns no longer snap back open when collapsed.

- New "What's new" window after updates; reopen it with /posekit changelog.

Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Oathbound
Description: A consent-based collar control plugin. Gameplay commands use ordinary in-game tells; relay-assisted pairing and encrypted catalog synchronization use the Oathbound Cloudflare service, while gameplay actions remain local to the Sub's client.
Punchline: Consent-based Owner/Sub control: outfit, title, gesture, and leash.

Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Cummy
Description:
Pair with someone over tells, then right-click them to layer cum onto a body part. Layers stack on top of their own current skin (Bibo body), are published through Penumbra so sync plugins show them to everyone, and stay until cleaned or dried off.
Requires Penumbra. 18+ content.
Punchline: Cum layering system for your paired partners.
Changelog:
- Forehead and Mouth are now one Face part with new full-face art in three stages: chin and mouth, then the forehead, then the whole face.
- Face is listed with the body parts, and Full Body now layers your face too.
- Licks land on your face, and licking a partner's face is a kiss. Faces drip onto the chest.
- Your saved face layers, blocks and custom face art carry over: Mouth becomes Face stage 1, Forehead becomes stage 2. The separate full-face custom image is now the Face override.
